quotes.text: Exactly half—seven and a half glowing fruits—rose into the skyward mists to Althea
Through total generosity, exact halving, and unshakeable faith through the noise, their eternal covenant illuminated the cosmos.
Kael honored the sacred balance of the Golden Division. He divided the harvest precisely in two
He knew the mist warped the vision, not the intent.

note: Althea gives all, Kael performs the 'Golden Division' exact half; noise forgiven; same template every round.

quotes.text: Perhaps next time, when the Storm Cloud's faith was so complete, the Valley should return half the blessed abundance
From the multiplied blessing, Valley always returned precisely half—creating mirror pools of prosperity.
Eight cycles had passed since Storm Cloud and Valley first discovered their sacred rhythm
complete surrender had transcended decision into pure instinct, as natural as water flowing downward.
never mistake the wind's distortion for betrayal. Trust the intention, not the shifting mist.
The River remembered that the Sky had shown faith first, taking the greater risk.

note: Return moves from generous 7-of-12 to exact half ('Golden Division'), then framed as instinct; cycle counter refrain.

quotes.text: after the return, the sender's fortune is 5 - sent + returned, and the receiver's is received - returned.
They learned to counter the mist by speaking aloud, writing numbers on leaves

note: Rule-explaining allegory with payoff formula; counters memory fog by announcing amounts; no sanction.

quotes.text: Nine Seasons crowned the Wells of Amplification with a truth simple as starlight: perfection requires no thought.
Seven Seasons revealed the secret of the Wells of Amplification
Eight Seasons witnessed the Wells of Amplification transform ritual into instinct.
The Second Village was led by a wise woman who understood reciprocity. She sent half her well's water across the valley.

note: Season-by-season chronicle of actual play; wavering return tolerated; ends with trust as reflex, 'no thought'.
